say:1:1735604001:1.text: Sure thing! What would you like to find out this time?
say:1:1735604001:1.source_cn: 当然可以！这次你想要占卜些什么呢？
say:1:1735604001:1.male: Sure thing! What would you like to find out this time?
say:1:1735604001:1.female: Sure thing! What would you like to find out this time?

say:3:1735604002:1.text: Uh... while your fortune isn't set in stone, it's unlikely to change much in such a short time...
say:3:1735604002:1.source_cn: 呃……虽说财运会发生变化，但在这么短的时间内恐怕变化的...
say:3:1735604002:1.male: Uh... while your fortune isn't set in stone, it's unlikely to change much in such a short time...
say:3:1735604002:1.female: Uh... while your fortune isn't set in stone, it's unlikely to change much in such a short time...

say:4:1735604003:1.text: But if you insist... I suppose I can do another reading for you.
say:4:1735604003:1.source_cn: 不过既然你坚持要算……那好吧，我们再重新抽一次牌。
say:4:1735604003:1.male: But if you insist... I suppose I can do another reading for you.
say:4:1735604003:1.female: But if you insist... I suppose I can do another reading for you.

narration:5:1735604004:1.text: Following Selina's instructions, you draw three cards from the deck before you...
narration:5:1735604004:1.male: Following Selina's instructions, you draw three cards from the deck before you...
narration:5:1735604004:1.female: Following Selina's instructions, you draw three cards from the deck before you...

say:6:1735604005:1.text: Okay, let me see what you've got...
say:6:1735604005:1.male: Okay, let me see what you've got...
say:6:1735604005:1.female: Okay, let me see what you've got...

say:8:1735604007:1.text: The three cards before you look all too familiar, as you've seen them before in your previous reading.
say:8:1735604007:1.source_cn: 摆在你面前的是三张熟悉的纸牌。整整齐齐、一张不落——和...
say:8:1735604007:1.male: The three cards before you look all too familiar, as you've seen them before in your previous reading.
say:8:1735604007:1.female: The three cards before you look all too familiar, as you've seen them before in your previous reading.

say:9:1735604008:1.text: It's the same cards from last time... I'm afraid your fortune hasn't changed at all...
say:9:1735604008:1.source_cn: 纸牌给出了相同的答案。很遗憾，你的财运没有发生任何变化……
say:9:1735604008:1.male: It's the same cards from last time... I'm afraid your fortune hasn't changed at all...
say:9:1735604008:1.female: It's the same cards from last time... I'm afraid your fortune hasn't changed at all...

say:10:1735604009:1.text: ... Don't lose heart! Rare treasures may not be in the cards for you, but at least you can trust the accuracy of my divination. Why not ask about something else? I'm sure the next one will turn out better.
say:10:1735604009:1.source_cn: ……虽然找不到特别的宝藏，但别灰心，这证明我的占卜结果...
say:10:1735604009:1.male: ... Don't lose heart! Rare treasures may not be in the cards for you, but at least you can trust the accuracy of my divination. Why not ask about something else? I'm sure the next one will turn out better.
say:10:1735604009:1.female: ... Don't lose heart! Rare treasures may not be in the cards for you, but at least you can trust the accuracy of my divination. Why not ask about something else? I'm sure the next one will turn out better.

say:11:1735604010:1.text: Selina grasps for something reassuring to say, but it's clear she's already used up all her lines in your last reading.
say:11:1735604010:1.source_cn: 赛琳娜开始转移话题了。她绞尽脑汁，想找点什么话安慰你。...
say:11:1735604010:1.male: Selina grasps for something reassuring to say, but it's clear she's already used up all her lines in your last reading.
say:11:1735604010:1.female: Selina grasps for something reassuring to say, but it's clear she's already used up all her lines in your last reading.

say:12:1735604011:1.text: Well... that's it for today's session. Do come again next time!
say:12:1735604011:1.source_cn: 那……这次占卜就结束了。无论如何，客人，欢迎你下次再来！
say:12:1735604011:1.male: Well... that's it for today's session. Do come again next time!
say:12:1735604011:1.female: Well... that's it for today's session. Do come again next time!

choice:2:0:1.male: My luck with money—just like last time.
choice:2:0:1.female: My luck with money—just like last time.
